title: Die temperature in a ramp
finding: The die reading rose from 23 C to 156 C as the clamp current climbed to 39.8 A, and peaked at 161 C.

caveats.text: Single channel, one unit, run to destruction with no thermal guard.
The die sensor is the controller's own, not a measurement of the output transistors.
Why the speed and current fell at about 100.1 s is not established by this capture.
The clamp reads about -0.85 A with no current flowing; the offset is not removed.
The die reading stays at 156 C once telemetry is lost; the plot ends where that starts.

reduction: Logged frames; frames in throttle or speed transients are excluded. Shown from 8 s to the loss of bus voltage telemetry.
